raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-MAR-SecondIdentityTargetingSocialProtection",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Inaccurate or duplicate identity data due to poor quality of legacy databases could exclude eligible citizens and undermine targeting.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Implement rigorous data cleaning, biometric deduplication, and pilot testing before national rollout; continuously monitor data quality through EFC system.",
      "evidence": "Existing databases have inconsistent quality and formats, risking inaccuracies and false exclusions (page 4)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Biometric enrollment may fail in remote or isolated areas lacking reliable power or connectivity, limiting coverage of vulnerable populations.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Deploy mobile enrollment units with satellite links, provide backup power, and schedule regular maintenance visits to remote CSCs.",
      "evidence": "Mobile units and satellite equipment are used to enroll people in isolated areas (page 11)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Operationalization of the National Registry Agency (NRA) could be delayed due to institutional capacity constraints and simultaneous system rollout.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Phase NRA staffing and governance setup ahead of full system hand‑over; use interim management by DIST until NRA is fully functional.",
      "evidence": "Rapid expansion strained MoI capacity; operationalizing NRA is challenging (page 52)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Fiduciary risk from reliance on Excel spreadsheets and overlapping budget lines may cause reporting errors and audit findings.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Adopt the new FM software for IFR preparation; create distinct budget codes for project activities to avoid duplication.",
      "evidence": "Use of Excel and duplicate budget line AMO‑TADAMON identified as FM risk (page 22)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Potential duplication of expenditures with other World Bank‑financed programs could lead to over‑statement of costs.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Cross‑check project expenditures against existing World Bank program budgets; require justification for any shared cost items.",
      "evidence": "Risk of duplication due to same budget line for programs already financed by the World Bank (page 22)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Informal sector workers may avoid enrollment fearing tax exposure, reducing coverage and equity of the system.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Conduct targeted outreach explaining confidentiality safeguards; involve trade unions and NGOs to build trust among informal workers.",
      "evidence": "Informal workers are wary of providing information due to perceived taxation risks (page 53)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Insufficient communication could exclude vulnerable groups (women, disabled, remote residents) from registering for DCSID.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement inclusive communication campaigns via TV, radio, SMS, and community facilitators; monitor enrollment gaps and adjust outreach.",
      "evidence": "Exclusion risk due to inefficient communication and unclear registration processes (page 85)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Improper disposal of electronic equipment (mobile units, laptops) may generate e‑waste and environmental harm.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Follow MoI asset‑management e‑waste procedures; partner with certified recyclers and conduct staff training on disposal protocols.",
      "evidence": "Risks associated with use of electronic devices include potential generation of e‑waste (page 85)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Changes in data‑protection regulations or non‑compliance could halt system deployment or lead to legal challenges.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Embed privacy‑by‑design; continuously monitor legal updates; conduct periodic compliance audits against Law 09‑08 and ESF requirements.",
      "evidence": "Project must follow national data‑protection law (Law 09‑08) and best practices (page 55)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Increasing frequency and severity of climate‑related shocks may overwhelm social‑protection targeting capacity.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Strengthen real‑time data updates in SR; develop rapid‑response protocols for drought/flood events; allocate contingency funds for emergency transfers.",
      "evidence": "Climate‑related shocks (droughts, floods) represent significant risks to the economy and target population (pages 2‑3)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Integrating DCSID into multiple social programs may encounter interoperability failures, delaying digital authentication rollout.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Adopt standardized APIs, conduct phased integration testing with each program, and maintain a dedicated technical liaison team.",
      "evidence": "Goal to integrate DCSID into 6‑8 programs; PBCs track digital authentication (pages 34‑35)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "MoI and PMU may lack sufficient skilled personnel to maintain and upgrade the NPR/SR platforms over the project life.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish the Center of Excellence, provide continuous training, and implement knowledge‑transfer agreements with technology partners.",
      "evidence": "Capacity strain noted; Center of Excellence to support sustainability (pages 52‑54)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Procurement of maintenance contracts for biometric and IT systems could be delayed, affecting system uptime.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Use the World Bank’s STEP system for early procurement planning; pre‑qualify vendors and set clear timelines in the POM.",
      "evidence": "Procurement risks considered low but require POM procedures to guarantee timely completion (page 79)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Data breach or unauthorized access to biometric information could erode public trust and trigger legal liabilities.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Implement robust encryption, role‑based access controls, regular security audits, and incident‑response plans aligned with national law.",
      "evidence": "Data privacy and protection measures are part of project design; risk of exclusion linked to privacy concerns (pages 55‑57)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Currency fluctuations between EUR, USD and MAD may affect the real value of financing and cost estimates.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 2,
      "mitigation": "Lock exchange rates for major disbursements; include a modest contingency buffer in the budget for exchange‑rate movements.",
      "evidence": "Currency equivalents listed (MAD 10.86 = EUR1, EUR 0.89 = US$1) indicating exposure to FX risk (datasheet)."
    }
  ]
}

risks.description: Inaccurate or duplicate identity data due to poor quality of legacy databases could exclude eligible citizens and undermine targeting.
risks.mitigation: Implement rigorous data cleaning, biometric deduplication, and pilot testing before national rollout; continuously monitor data quality through EFC system.
risks.evidence: Existing databases have inconsistent quality and formats, risking inaccuracies and false exclusions (page 4).

risks.description: Biometric enrollment may fail in remote or isolated areas lacking reliable power or connectivity, limiting coverage of vulnerable populations.
risks.mitigation: Deploy mobile enrollment units with satellite links, provide backup power, and schedule regular maintenance visits to remote CSCs.
risks.evidence: Mobile units and satellite equipment are used to enroll people in isolated areas (page 11).

risks.description: Operationalization of the National Registry Agency (NRA) could be delayed due to institutional capacity constraints and simultaneous system rollout.
risks.mitigation: Phase NRA staffing and governance setup ahead of full system hand‑over; use interim management by DIST until NRA is fully functional.
risks.evidence: Rapid expansion strained MoI capacity; operationalizing NRA is challenging (page 52).

risks.description: Fiduciary risk from reliance on Excel spreadsheets and overlapping budget lines may cause reporting errors and audit findings.
risks.mitigation: Adopt the new FM software for IFR preparation; create distinct budget codes for project activities to avoid duplication.
risks.evidence: Use of Excel and duplicate budget line AMO‑TADAMON identified as FM risk (page 22).

risks.description: Potential duplication of expenditures with other World Bank‑financed programs could lead to over‑statement of costs.
risks.mitigation: Cross‑check project expenditures against existing World Bank program budgets; require justification for any shared cost items.
risks.evidence: Risk of duplication due to same budget line for programs already financed by the World Bank (page 22).

risks.description: Informal sector workers may avoid enrollment fearing tax exposure, reducing coverage and equity of the system.
risks.mitigation: Conduct targeted outreach explaining confidentiality safeguards; involve trade unions and NGOs to build trust among informal workers.
risks.evidence: Informal workers are wary of providing information due to perceived taxation risks (page 53).

risks.description: Insufficient communication could exclude vulnerable groups (women, disabled, remote residents) from registering for DCSID.
risks.mitigation: Implement inclusive communication campaigns via TV, radio, SMS, and community facilitators; monitor enrollment gaps and adjust outreach.
risks.evidence: Exclusion risk due to inefficient communication and unclear registration processes (page 85).

risks.description: Improper disposal of electronic equipment (mobile units, laptops) may generate e‑waste and environmental harm.
risks.mitigation: Follow MoI asset‑management e‑waste procedures; partner with certified recyclers and conduct staff training on disposal protocols.
risks.evidence: Risks associated with use of electronic devices include potential generation of e‑waste (page 85).

risks.description: Changes in data‑protection regulations or non‑compliance could halt system deployment or lead to legal challenges.
risks.mitigation: Embed privacy‑by‑design; continuously monitor legal updates; conduct periodic compliance audits against Law 09‑08 and ESF requirements.
risks.evidence: Project must follow national data‑protection law (Law 09‑08) and best practices (page 55).

risks.description: Increasing frequency and severity of climate‑related shocks may overwhelm social‑protection targeting capacity.
risks.mitigation: Strengthen real‑time data updates in SR; develop rapid‑response protocols for drought/flood events; allocate contingency funds for emergency transfers.
risks.evidence: Climate‑related shocks (droughts, floods) represent significant risks to the economy and target population (pages 2‑3).

risks.description: Integrating DCSID into multiple social programs may encounter interoperability failures, delaying digital authentication rollout.
risks.mitigation: Adopt standardized APIs, conduct phased integration testing with each program, and maintain a dedicated technical liaison team.
risks.evidence: Goal to integrate DCSID into 6‑8 programs; PBCs track digital authentication (pages 34‑35).

risks.description: MoI and PMU may lack sufficient skilled personnel to maintain and upgrade the NPR/SR platforms over the project life.
risks.mitigation: Establish the Center of Excellence, provide continuous training, and implement knowledge‑transfer agreements with technology partners.
risks.evidence: Capacity strain noted; Center of Excellence to support sustainability (pages 52‑54).

risks.description: Procurement of maintenance contracts for biometric and IT systems could be delayed, affecting system uptime.
risks.mitigation: Use the World Bank’s STEP system for early procurement planning; pre‑qualify vendors and set clear timelines in the POM.
risks.evidence: Procurement risks considered low but require POM procedures to guarantee timely completion (page 79).

risks.description: Data breach or unauthorized access to biometric information could erode public trust and trigger legal liabilities.
risks.mitigation: Implement robust encryption, role‑based access controls, regular security audits, and incident‑response plans aligned with national law.
risks.evidence: Data privacy and protection measures are part of project design; risk of exclusion linked to privacy concerns (pages 55‑57).

risks.description: Currency fluctuations between EUR, USD and MAD may affect the real value of financing and cost estimates.
risks.mitigation: Lock exchange rates for major disbursements; include a modest contingency buffer in the budget for exchange‑rate movements.
risks.evidence: Currency equivalents listed (MAD 10.86 = EUR1, EUR 0.89 = US$1) indicating exposure to FX risk (datasheet).
